resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, or VASP with NEB module)
Pseudopotential/PAW datasets for B, Li, I

access.notes: Standard pseudopotential library, e.g., SSSP for Quantum ESPRESSO.
Build from paper description: lattice a=8.41 Å, b=2.93 Å, 2×3 supercell with 49 B atoms, hexagon-hole arrangement, vacuum layer >15 Å. Exact atomic coordinates defined by the χ3 hexagon-hole pattern.
